title: 第17章 三大圣子VS神子第18章 君家神子实力初展拜服声一片
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: “我…我自然也没资格，但是我再怎么也比他要好吧，好歹我现在已经是尊者境了，而他呢？毫无修为，一无是处的废物”
君大威看见神子质问自己，心中虽然紧张，但也指着林琅天死鸭撑饭盖，嘴硬说道；
一旁老神在在的林琅天正品着仙茗，吃着灵果，看见别人指着自己骂废物，顿时觉得手中的灵果不香了。
“君大威，我记得不错的话，你好像原来不姓君吧，是你父亲苦苦哀求我君家，想入我君家门下，世代忠诚为君家效力才被赐君姓吧。
而且你还是君百成身边的狗腿子吧，怎么？君百成他没敢出头找我，让你这个傻帽来找茬。”
君傲天说完话，气势锁定君大威，君大威动不了了。
就在这时，有另一股气息涌进，化解了君傲天的气势锁定，让君大威得以逃脱，躲到来人身后。
“君百成，我以为你要做缩头乌龟呢，怎么憋不住了吗？”
来人身材高大，气势强烈，生死境修为显露无疑，略为自豪的看向君傲天：
“堂堂君家的神子不会就只会，欺压自家同辈的子弟吧，岂不是让外人看笑话”。
“我说你怎么敢面对我了呢。原来是修为突破生死境了啊，君百成，君家大圣子”。
“哼，若非家族的资源大部份向你倾斜，我又何至今时才能突破，早就甩你无影了”
君百成一脸的不服气。
看着君百成那欠揍的样子，君傲天笑了，笑的很大声，很敞亮。
一旁的林琅天摇头晃脑，完犊子喽！有人要倒霉了。
林琅天刚感叹完，君傲天气势爆发了，生死境巅峰的气势冲天而起，强大的气息威压在场的众人。
当然林琅天例外，这对他来说如沐春风而已。
“这…怎么可能…君傲天，你竟然突破到生死境巅峰了？”
君百成彻底站不住脚了。
“来吧，君百成，给你个机会，一个挑战我的机会”
君傲天看着君百成，轻蔑一笑。
君百成脸一阵青一阵白，骑虎难下，陷入进退两难，打也不是，不打也不是。
打吧，肯定是输，境界不如人，更何况还有对方荒古圣体加持。
content_en:
"I...of course I am not qualified, but I am better than him no matter what. After all, I am already in the Venerable realm now, and what about him? He is a useless waste with no cultivation."
Jun Dawei saw the Son of God questioning him. Although he was nervous, he pointed at Lin Langtian's dead duck and said firmly;
Lin Langtian, with the old god on his side, was sipping some fairy tea and eating spiritual fruit. When he saw others pointing at him and calling him a waste, he suddenly felt that the spiritual fruit in his hand no longer smelled good.
"Jun Dawei, if I remember correctly, it seems that your surname was not Jun originally. It was your father who begged me hard to join my Jun family, and he was given the Jun surname after he had been loyal to the Jun family for generations.
And you are still Jun Baicheng’s lackluster, right? Jun Baicheng didn't dare to come forward to find me, leaving you, a fool, to find trouble. "
After Jun Aotian finished speaking, his momentum locked onto Jun Dawei, and Jun Dawei could not move.
At this moment, another breath surged in, breaking Jun Aotian's momentum lock, allowing Jun Dawei to escape and hide behind the visitor.
"Jun Baicheng, I thought you were going to be a coward, why can't you hold it in anymore?"
The person who came was tall and powerful, and his cultivation in the realm of life and death was clearly revealed. He looked at Jun Aotian with a little pride:
"The divine son of the dignified Jun family can't just bully the children of his own generation. Wouldn't it be a joke to outsiders?"
"I said, how dare you face me? It turns out that your cultivation has broken through the realm of life and death, Jun Baicheng, the great saint son of the Jun family."
"Hmph, if most of the family's resources hadn't been tilted towards you, how could I have made a breakthrough now? I would have left you alone long ago."
Jun Baicheng looked unconvinced.
Seeing Jun Baicheng's look of needing a beating, Jun Aotian laughed, loudly and openly.
Lin Langtian on the side shook his head, "I'm done!" Someone is going to be in trouble.
Just as Lin Langtian finished sighing, Jun Aotian's momentum exploded. The aura at the peak of the life and death realm soared into the sky, and the powerful aura suppressed everyone present.
Of course, Lin Langtian was the exception. This was just a breath of fresh air for him.
"This...how is it possible...Jun Aotian, you have broken through to the peak of life and death?"
Jun Baicheng couldn't stand at all.
"Come on, Jun Baicheng, give you a chance, a chance to challenge me."
Jun Aotian looked at Jun Baicheng and smiled contemptuously.
Jun Baicheng's face turned green and white. He was riding a tiger and couldn't get off. He was in a dilemma, whether to fight or not to fight.
If you fight, you will definitely lose. Your realm is not as good as others, not to mention the blessing of the opponent's ancient holy body.
title_en: Chapter 17 The Three Holy Sons VS the Son of God Chapter 18 The Lord’s Son of the Jun Family Shows His Strength for the First Time and Everyone Admires Him
